# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Scarcely 19 (nearly fourteen in September of Volume 1, turning fifteen during that school year; three years later he is nineteen)  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v2 c26 P14](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0014)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c30 P37](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and college student  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c26 P8](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, handsome boy with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a mouth twisted into a teasing smile. As he grows into a young man, he becomes broad-shouldered, frank-faced, and manly, with a strong, well-modeled chin.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Gilbert is clever, ambitious, and determined to succeed through hard work and self-reliance. Though he enjoys teasing girls in his younger school days, he matures into a thoughtful, courteous, and earnest young man with high ideals. He possesses a strong sense of duty to his community and a desire to add to human knowledge by fighting disease and pain. In his rivalries and friendships, he is generous, forgiving, and capable of quiet self-sacrifice.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014)_

## History

Gilbert Blythe returned to Avonlea after three years in Alberta with his father and resumed his studies at the Avonlea school. On his first afternoon back, he teased new student Anne Shirley by calling her 'Carrots,' prompting her to smash a slate over his head and declare a lifelong grudge against him. Despite Gilbert's public apologies and attempts to make peace over the years, Anne steadfastly ignored him while they engaged in a fierce academic rivalry. Both were promoted to the fifth class, joined Miss Stacy's Queen's Academy preparation class, and ultimately tied for first place on the Island-wide Entrance examinations to Queen's Academy, where Gilbert won the bronze medal for classics. Due to his father's financial constraints, Gilbert took the White Sands schoolteaching position for a year to earn money for college. Learning that Anne wished to stay in Avonlea to care for Marilla Cuthbert after Matthew's death, Gilbert generously gave up the Avonlea school so she could have it instead. Touched by his sacrifice, Anne thanked him on Barry's hill and offered her forgiveness, beginning a warm friendship and academic partnership. After a year of teaching in White Sands, during which he helped organize the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, Gilbert won the Governor-General's medal at Queen's and prepared to attend Redmond College alongside Anne.

- Spent three years living in Alberta with his sick father during his childhood  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
